problem_type: Internal capability aliases and execution transitions are projected one-for-one to the model
symptom: The model must choose among roughly 50 internal descriptors and can select gate/start/subscribe/materialize transitions instead of expressing one creative intent.
direct_cause: agentToolCatalog combines document, canvas, timeline, production, generation, and Skill descriptors; regex/sticky profiles filter names but do not collapse intent or risk.
class_root: There is no single semantic model-surface manifest separating canonical capabilities from Host-only transitions.
affected_population: All alias additions to the capability registry
All paid or approval-bearing generation/ProductionRun transitions
internal_only_reason: The semantic grouping and Nomi risk ceiling are application product contracts pinned to the M0 mapping and approved architecture docs.
invariants: Every model tool names a user intent and maps to canonical capabilities.
Host-only transitions never enter the model projection.
Alias deletion occurs in the same migration commit as semantic replacement.
generality_proof: All six descriptor groups and registry aliases pass through the manifest boundary; new capabilities must declare intent, risk, phase, and projection before becoming model-visible.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Host policy and effect authorization stay outside model projections.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Policy changes are validated at the Host boundary.
Tier and tainted-content cases are covered.

recurrence.reason: Every future capability or alias can recreate model overload and unsafe transition exposure unless the manifest is the only model boundary.
same_class_scan: Checked generation and ProductionRun gate/start/subscribe/review/materialize names for Host-only treatment.

prevention.invariant: Only versioned semantic descriptors are model-visible; canonical aliases and Host transitions cannot leak through profile filtering.
prevention.failure_mode: A descriptor without intent/risk/capabilityRefs is rejected from the manifest; Host-only entries are omitted rather than silently downgraded.
prevention.strategy: Generate one manifest from canonical registry, merge aliases by user intent, and delete the old model projection in the same commit.

legacy_paths.rationale: M1 does not change model tool descriptors; semantic projection remains an M2 scope.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: This is a Nomi projection contract; no third-party dependency controls alias grouping.

migration: Freeze existing run descriptor contractHash and permissions; old MCP aliases may remain versioned readers only and are never re-exposed to new model turns.
residual_risks: The 49 catalog plus one wire-level gate count must be confirmed against the inaccessible maintainer comment before implementation.
Deferred Loading remains explicitly unchosen until M2 A/B evidence.
